title: French Empanada with Grassland Gruyère
description: A French twist on the traditional Uruguayan empanada, filled with grassy Gruyère and silky chicken.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the melted butter, egg, and mix until the dough comes together.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a small bowl, mix together the chicken, Gruyère cheese, and thyme.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops with a little bit of water and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
